commandPalette.title: Command menu

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Shortcuts work everywhere except in text fields.

inbox.emptyDescription: Messages appear here once a mail account is connected.

tasks.emptyDescription: Tasks found in your messages are listed here.

digest.emptyDescription: The digest summarizes new mails daily, to read and listen to. Set it up or generate one now.

search.emptyDescription: Search covers all synced messages and attachments.

settings.more: Mail accounts, language models and notifications will be configured here.
settings.serverDescription: Status of the connection to the ollamail server.

admin.auditDescription: Sign-ins, role changes, key rotation and other security events.

admin.aiDescription: Providers, model per task, hardware profile and cloud access.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.emptyDescription: Security events such as sign-ins and role changes are recorded here.

taskDescriptions.rag_chat: Answers questions with sources from the mail.

cloud.label: Allow cloud LLMs
cloud.description: Allows providers marked as cloud. Default: off.
cloud.warningTitle: Data is sent to third parties
cloud.warning: While cloud LLMs are allowed, ollamail sends mail content (text, subject, sender, attachment text) to the cloud provider of every task assigned to one. Check the data processing agreement, server location and retention first. All users see a permanent notice.

providers.environmentHint: From the environment (OLLAMAIL_LLM_*), cannot be changed here.
providers.deleteDescription: The provider and its API key are removed.
providers.inUse: The provider is still assigned to tasks. Assign them to another provider first.

test.unreachable: Not reachable. Check the URL, the network and whether the service is running.
test.unauthorized: Access denied (HTTP {{status}}). Check the API key.
test.rejected: Request rejected (HTTP {{status}}). Check URL and type.
test.failed: Unexpected response. Check URL and type.

form.description: An endpoint that serves language models, e.g. Ollama, vLLM or an OpenAI-compatible service.
form.name: Name
form.nameHint: Lower-case letters, digits, - and _. Cannot be changed.
form.nameInvalid: Only lower-case letters, digits, - and _ (max. 32 characters).
form.baseUrlInvalid: Enter an http(s) URL without credentials.
form.apiKeyHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
form.apiKeyKeep: Set. Leave empty to keep it.
form.isCloudHint: Mail content leaves the instance. Only usable while cloud LLMs are allowed.

assignments.modelRequired: Enter a model for the chosen provider.
assignments.blocked: Cloud provider, but cloud LLMs are blocked: this task does not run.
assignments.hint: Changes apply from the next job on, without a restart.

performance.profileDescription: Default models and context size. Applies to tasks without a model of their own.
performance.concurrencyDescription: Concurrent language model requests per worker (1–{{max}}). 1 on CPU hosts.

digest.title: Digest
digest.firstScheduled: The first digest arrives on {{date}}. You can also generate one now.
digest.inProgressHint: Depending on the hardware this takes a few minutes. The page updates by itself.

errors.digest_failed: The digest could not be generated.
errors.llm_cloud_disabled: A cloud model is set for summaries, but cloud models are turned off. Please contact your administrator.
errors.tts_voice_not_available: The selected voice is not available. Choose another voice in the settings.
errors.stalled: Generation was stopped because it took too long.

settings.title: Digest settings
settings.enabledDescription: Generates the digest automatically at the set time.
settings.timeDescription: The digest is ready at this time.
settings.lengthDescription: Short covers only the most important points.
settings.mailboxesDescription: The digest summarizes mails from these mailboxes.
settings.generateDescription: Summarizes the mails since the last digest.

feed.title: Private podcast feed
feed.description: Subscribe to your digests in a podcast app.
feed.warning: Anyone who knows the feed URL can listen to and read your digests without signing in. Do not share it.
feed.qrLabel: QR code of the feed URL
feed.shownOnce: The URL is only shown now. If you lose it, create a new one.
feed.activeSince: The feed has been active since {{date}}.
feed.urlHidden: For security reasons the URL is only shown when it is created.
feed.rotateWarning: The previous URL stops working immediately. Podcast apps need to subscribe to the new URL.
feed.revokeWarning: The feed URL and all audio links in it stop working.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The address does not exist or is no longer available.

errors.network: The server is not reachable. Check your connection.
errors.badRequest: The request could not be processed.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.notFound: The requested item was not found.

errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please wait a moment.

auth.passwordTooShort_one: The password must have at least {{count}} character.
auth.passwordTooShort_other: The password must have at least {{count}} characters.

login.title: Sign in to ollamail
login.invalidCredentials: E-mail address or password is incorrect.
login.throttled: Too many sign-in attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
login.noMethods: No sign-in method is configured. Contact your administrator.

setup.title: Set up ollamail
setup.description: Create the first account. It gets administrator rights and can add further users and sign-in methods.
setup.passwordHint: At least 12 characters, unless the server requires a different length.
setup.tokenHint: Shown in the server log at start-up (setup_code) or set via OLLAMAIL_SETUP_TOKEN.
setup.alreadyInitialized: This instance has already been set up. Sign in instead.
setup.providersDescription: Connect Microsoft Entra ID, Google, GitHub or LDAP so that others can sign in with their existing account. You can do this later in the admin area.

account.title: Account
account.timeZoneDescription: Used for dates, digests and reminders.

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.description: This page is only available to administrators.

mail.imagesBlocked_one: 1 external image was blocked to protect your privacy.
mail.imagesBlocked_other: {{count}} external images were blocked to protect your privacy.
mail.noMailboxesDescription: Add a mailbox to see your messages here.
mail.noUnreadDescription: You have read everything in this view.
mail.importingDescription: Messages are being imported and appear here shortly.
mail.emptyDescription: New messages appear here as they arrive.

mailboxes.title: Mailboxes
mailboxes.settingsDescription: Add mail accounts, choose folders, see the sync status.
mailboxes.emptyDescription: Connect a mail account. Messages are imported and processed on this server.
mailboxes.privacyNote: Removing a mailbox deletes its messages, attachments, tasks and search index from ollamail. Nothing is deleted on the mail server.
mailboxes.connected: Mailbox connected. The import starts in a moment.
mailboxes.connectFailed: The mailbox could not be connected
mailboxes.removeDescription_one: {{name}} and its {{formatted}} message, with attachments, tasks and search index, are deleted from ollamail. The mail server is not changed.
mailboxes.removeDescription_other: {{name}} and its {{formatted}} messages, with attachments, tasks and search index, are deleted from ollamail. The mail server is not changed.
mailboxes.noProviders: No mailbox types are available on this server. Ask your administrator.

imap.title: IMAP
imap.description: Any provider with IMAP access, e.g. mailbox.org, Posteo or your own server.

gmail.title: Google
gmail.description: Gmail and Google Workspace. Sign in with your Google account.
gmail.connectHint: You will be taken to Google to allow access to your mailbox. ollamail stores only an encrypted access token, never your password.
gmail.recommended: For Gmail, signing in with Google is recommended over an app password.

graph.title: Microsoft 365
graph.description: Exchange Online and Outlook. Sign in with your Microsoft account.
graph.connectHint: You will be taken to Microsoft to allow access to your mailbox. ollamail stores only encrypted access tokens, never your password.
graph.recommended: This provider requires signing in with Microsoft.

hints.app_password: This provider needs an app password for IMAP. Create one in your account's security settings.
hints.enable_imap: IMAP access may have to be enabled in the provider's web settings first.
hints.oauth_required: This provider no longer accepts passwords for IMAP.
hints.mail_password: This provider uses a separate password for mail programs.
hints.guessed: The server was guessed from the domain. Check it with your provider if the test fails.

form.title: IMAP account

form.displayNameDescription: Shown in the mailbox list. Defaults to the address.
form.suggestedKnown: Settings filled in for this provider.
form.usernameDescription: Only if it differs from the address.
form.acceptAnyCertificateDescription: Only for servers with a self-signed certificate. Your administrator must allow this.
form.duplicate: This mailbox has already been added.
